_comment: ROMA-compatible task-graph template for a design-gate run. Import into your task-graph tool (sprint_graph.py) (goal->task nodes, depends_on edges) or use bin/run_design_gate.py which executes T1 directly and emits a plan.json for roma.py verify.

cognitive_types.ACT: money/state-moving — the loop NEVER auto-executes; marks proposed

goal.title: Ship <page|flyer> for <site> through the design gate

manifest_schema.artifact_path: path to the built artifact (html file, pdf, png…)
manifest_schema.notes: free text: what changed, links, context
manifest_schema.target: the page route or flyer name

nodes.title: protocol-checklist: run run_design_gate.py --job manifest.json; record per-protocol PASS/FAIL + evidence
design-review: human-eye review vs SITE_REGISTRY language + PROTOCOLS P1-P6; view the artifact live firsthand (P12)
copy-check: COPY_STANDARDS pass/fail per line (Pinker C1-C5, Cialdini C1-C6 honest, numbers N1-N3)
red-team/steelman: roma.py verify --file plan.json over the 8 lenses; verdict must be approve or revise + re-gate
artifact-verification: open the artifact live; re-run failing checks; confirm render
ship-decision: PROPOSED only — merge/deploy/publish needs explicit approval (tiered gating). The gate never deploys.
